Hermitate

It’s a 3D point-and-click adventure and a deeply emotional social drama that explores the struggles of self-discovery, confronting inner demons, and finding hope in the darkest moments.

The game is the fourth in The Little Kite series.

The project has been in development since 2023 and is currently ongoing.
